notes: Hard ML-artifact task. The agent must (a) reconstruct a complete causal-transformer forward pass purely from a state dict and a hyperparameter file, (b) reproduce, to a tight tolerance, oracle-computed scores for every sample, (c) persist a low-rank factorization of every linear weight matrix whose significant-singular-value count respects the configured rank, and (d) keep the whole engine under a strict 6000-byte source budget. Reasoning depth (3): deriving the exact norm/MHA/GELU arithmetic from the weight layout and matching float-level outputs. Quantitative correctness (3): hidden cases compare scores within 2e-3 and enforce low-rank singular-value bounds. Hidden-case generalization (3): four hidden cases vary d/layers/vocab/ctx/heads/rank, so the engine must be architecture-parametric, not fixture-hardcoded. Resource pressure (2): hard source byte budget plus tightly bounded runtime.
